skill.name: excalidraw-diagram-generator
skill.description: Create editable Excalidraw diagrams from natural language. Supports process, architecture, data, class, sequence, relationship, mind map, swimlane, and ER diagrams.
skill.summary: Turn structured ideas and workflows into editable Excalidraw diagrams.
skill.author: github

security_audit.summary: The 163 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown, diagram metadata, identifier logic, and documented local file writes. No shell execution or programmatic network request was found. Two semantic risks remain in handling untrusted icon libraries and icon paths.

remediation.issue: Untrusted library metadata can be loaded into agent context.
remediation.suggestion: Escape generated Markdown, sanitize text fields, and treat downloaded library files as untrusted data. Avoid reading raw library content into model context.

remediation.issue: Icon names can resolve outside the selected library.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and separators, resolve the icon path, and verify it remains within the library icons directory before reading.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted library content can enter model context
semantic_findings.description: Downloaded library names are copied unescaped into reference.md, and complete items are copied into icon JSON. SKILL.md directs agents to read these generated files, enabling indirect prompt injection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow from a downloaded library into agent-readable Markdown and JSON is explicit. Exploitation requires a malicious or compromised library.

semantic_findings.title: Icon name permits local JSON path traversal
semantic_findings.description: The icon name is joined into a path without rejecting absolute paths or separators. A prompt-controlled name can select another local JSON file for parsing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Pathlib accepts absolute path components and traversal segments here, and icon_name is direct command-line input. The .json suffix limits but does not prevent local file selection.

content.value_statement: Manual diagram creation is slow and inconsistent. This skill converts natural language into editable Excalidraw files using templates, layout guidance, and optional icon tools.
actual_capabilities: Generates editable Excalidraw files from natural language descriptions.
Supports flowcharts, mind maps, architecture, data flow, class, sequence, swimlane, relationship, and ER diagrams.
Uses bundled templates for consistent Excalidraw structure and styling.
Applies layout, spacing, color, font, and element-count guidance.
Splits Excalidraw libraries into individual icon files and a reference index.
Adds library icons, labels, and styled arrows to existing diagrams with Python tools.
limitations: Complex curves use simple straight or basic curved lines.
Automatic generation does not embed images.
The workflow does not provide automatic collision detection.
Specialized icons require a compatible Excalidraw library and local setup.

use_cases.title: Map Product Workflows
use_cases.description: Create flowcharts or swimlanes that show decisions, responsibilities, and handoffs.

use_cases.title: Document Software Design
use_cases.description: Build architecture, class, sequence, and data flow diagrams for technical documentation.

use_cases.title: Organize Research Topics
use_cases.description: Turn themes, evidence, and related concepts into a readable mind map.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Flowchart
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw flowchart for [process]. Include [steps], decision points, and a clear start and end.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a small sequential process.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Team Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a swimlane diagram for [workflow]. Use lanes for [roles] and show every handoff, decision, and final outcome.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for processes shared across teams.

prompt_templates.title: System Interaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sequence diagram for [scenario]. Include [actors], synchronous and asynchronous messages, return values, and activation periods.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for runtime interactions between services.

prompt_templates.title: Cloud Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excalidraw architecture diagram for [system]. Use [icon library] when available, label trust boundaries, and show protocols and data flows.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a detailed infrastructure design.

output_examples.input: Create a flowchart for account registration with email verification.
output: A top-to-bottom flow with registration, verification, retry, and completion paths.
A short summary with element counts and opening instructions.

output_examples.input: Show the order service interaction from checkout through shipment.
output: An editable sequence diagram with customer, checkout, payment, inventory, and shipping participants.
Labeled requests, responses, failure paths, lifelines, and activation periods.

output_examples.input: Create a mind map for a machine learning research review.
output: A central research topic with branches for methods, datasets, evaluation, findings, and open questions.
Consistent colors and spacing for fast scanning in Excalidraw.

best_practices: Provide the diagram type, key elements, relationships, and preferred flow direction.
Keep the first diagram below 20 elements and split detailed subsystems into separate views.
Review labels, arrow direction, spacing, and source data before sharing the file.
anti_patterns: Do not request one crowded diagram for every system detail.
Do not use unlabeled arrows when relationships or protocols are important.
Do not load icon libraries from unknown sources without reviewing their contents.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an editable .excalidraw file that opens in Excalidraw or a compatible editor.

faq.question: Which diagram types are supported?
faq.answer: It supports flowcharts, relationships, mind maps, architecture, data flow, swimlanes, classes, sequences, and ER diagrams.

faq.question: Does it require external packages?
faq.answer: Basic generation does not. Optional icon and arrow tools use Python standard-library modules.

faq.question: Can it use cloud service icons?
faq.answer: Yes. Download and split a compatible Excalidraw library before requesting those icons.

faq.question: Can it update an existing diagram?
faq.answer: The bundled scripts can add icons, labels, and arrows to an existing Excalidraw file.

faq.question: How should large diagrams be handled?
faq.answer: Start with a high-level view, then create separate diagrams for detailed subsystems or workflows.
